description:
octo_pi is an Elixir/OTP port of pi-mono (TypeScript). The goal of this epic is to
replace the current flat MessageLog / Session architecture with one that mirrors
pi-mono's SessionManager + AgentSession design — typed, persistent, tree-shaped
session history; first-class compaction; and an extension hook system.

## Why

The pi-mono architecture was designed carefully and has proven itself. Elixir/OTP
is a better host for agents (fault tolerance, concurrency, hot reloading), but we
want to stay structurally close so learnings and tests can be ported directly.

## Reference implementation

All pi-mono source lives at tmp/pi-mono/ relative to the repo root:
  - tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts  (SessionManager)
  - tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts     (AgentSession)
  - tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/compaction.ts
  - tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts

## Current state (what changes)

  - apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message_log.ex       — flat list, REPLACED
  - apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session/state.ex     — holds :messages as MessageLog
  - apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex              — passes MessageLog.to_list directly to transport
  - apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/event.ex             — missing CompactionStart/End
  - apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex           — no compaction, no extensions

## Phases

Phase 1 — Foundation: SessionEntry types, SessionManager, JSONL persistence
Phase 2 — Wiring: migrate Session.State and Loop to use SessionManager
Phase 3 — Compaction: events, Compaction module, auto/manual compaction
Phase 4 — Extensions: behaviour, runner, compaction hooks, agent hooks, tool/command registration
Phase 5 — Branching: fork and navigate_tree
title: Align session architecture with pi-mono
